name: Moonlit Splendor Along Every Way
description: A freestanding street lamp crafted by the people of Liyue to celebrate the Moonchase Festival. Its hanging light fixtures are modeled after the full moon, fitting the theme of "chasing the moon" while creating a festive and joyful atmosphere.\n"At night, the moon shines bright as a mirror, its radiance filling every street." Under the glow of the street lamps, the entire street is bathed in brilliant "moonlight." Surrounded by such a scene, everyone offers their heartfelt wishes for the year to come.
